name: necroreview
description: NecroReview — resurrect a repository's best reviewers as Ghost Bots that review new PRs in their own voice.

scripts.bootstrap: npm run data && npm run personas && npm run index
scripts.demo: npm run build:ui && npm run start
scripts.test: npm run test -w @necroreview/core && npm run test -w @necroreview/bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @necroreview/core && npm run typecheck -w @necroreview/bridge && npm run typecheck -w @necroreview/ui
